title: Killzone Shadow Fall

achievements.reason: PlayStation 4 only: no Steam app, so there is no Steam achievement list. RAWG lists 49 trophies (RAWG's own percentages): nine level trophies (The Father, The Shadow, The Doctor, The Patriot, The Helghast, The Agent, The Handler, The Dead and The Destroyer, listed here from most to least common, which may be the level order); campaign trophies for Hard difficulty and Elite mode, no deaths, no civilian shots and finding 50% and then all collectibles; singleplayer feats such as zipline and adrenaline-rush kills; multiplayer trophies for maps, challenges, accolades, points and maxed Assault, Scout and Support abilities; co-op trophies for the four Combat Roles; and other trophies for playing as an Insurgent, Retro weapons, the jetpack, the minigun and boss kills. These could seed an original checklist.

game.blurb: Science-fiction first-person shooter from Guerrilla Games, published by Sony Computer Entertainment, released 2013-11-15 on PlayStation 4. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genre: Shooter. Chapters are broad sections drawn from the RAWG description, because there is no Steam list and no written StrategyWiki mission pages.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). PlayStation 4 only (RAWG lists only PlayStation 4 and only the PlayStation Store), and the Steam store list has no Killzone Shadow Fall app, so steam=None. RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3848); RAWG keeps "Killzone Shadow Fall Intercept" separately. StrategyWiki has no page under "Killzone Shadow Fall"; the guide is under "Killzone: Shadow Fall", a stub at completion stage 0 (in Category:Stubs). Only Controls (about 900 characters) and Table of Contents are written; Gameplay and Walkthrough are linked but not written, and there are no mission pages, so swNames could not be used. killzone.fandom.com redirects "Killzone: Shadow Fall" to "Killzone Shadow Fall", with about 66 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The four chapters are broad placeholders built only from the RAWG description. RAWG's trophy list does name nine levels, but their order is only guessed from unlock rates, so they were left for a later pass. Some trophies name the co-op Combat Roles and playing "as an Insurgent"; whether they belong to the separate Intercept entry is not stated in the data.
